1.consolidated_definition: Dar una serenata. La trulla ‘es un grupo de gente que sale en época de Navidad a pedir aguinaldo’, según Malaret. “Las trullas de a pie se componen de jente pobre, que no por eso se divierte menos: maraca en mano y tiple y carracho debajo del brazo.” , p. 134.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To serenade someone. A trulla is "a group of people who go out during the Christmas season to ask for aguinaldo," according to Malaret. "The pedestrian trullas are composed of poor people, who do not enjoy themselves any less: maraca in hand and tiple and carracho under their arm."
